summary: Compliance verification pass for Délices Mikaté Royal legal pages, cookie banner (Loi 25 gated PostHog), consent checkbox and allergen notice. 16/16 test scenarios executed via Playwright on the public preview URL. Everything works as documented — one minor UX nuance around the consent-checkbox validation mechanism reported.

integration_issues.issue: The consent checkbox uses the HTML5 `required` attribute AND a JS toast check inside onSubmit. Because `required` triggers native browser validation first, the JS toast 'Veuillez accepter la Politique de confidentialité et les Conditions générales de vente pour continuer.' is effectively unreachable in the regular happy path — the user only sees the small native browser tooltip. Submission IS correctly blocked (verified: no request fires, no toast, form not reset) and the box is highlighted, but the friendly French toast defined in OrderForm.jsx line 122 is dead code in this path. Consider dropping `required` on the checkbox so onSubmit runs and the toast is shown, or dropping the toast branch.

action_items: MINOR (optional): Decide whether to keep the native `required` on `order-consent-checkbox` OR the JS-toast fallback in OrderForm.onSubmit — currently both exist and the toast branch never runs. Recommended: remove `required` so the branded toast is what users see (consistent with the rest of the form UX).

NOTE (docs): the review request mentions submit button testid `order-submit`, but the actual testid in code is `order-form-submit-button` (constants/testIds.js). Reviewer should just be aware — code is fine, doc was slightly off.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderForm.jsx: `required` on the consent checkbox short-circuits the friendly toast validation in onSubmit — pick one path.

public/index.html: PostHog gating correctly reads `mr_cookie_consent_v1.analytics === true` and hooks `mr:consent-updated` for late-consent init. Also correctly calls `posthog.opt_out_capturing()` if user revokes analytics mid-session. Solid implementation.
LegalLayout is DRY and consistent — all 6 pages share the same wrapper, back-home link and footer. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 scenarios passed; 1 minor UX nuance flagged)

seed_data_creation: Submitted 1 test order via UI: customer_name='Test QA', phone='438-555-0100', address='Sorel-Tracy', 1x Mikaté Sucré (5 mikatés). Success toast 'Commande enregistrée ! Nous vous contactons sous peu.' received.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 legal pages route correctly: /politique-confidentialite, /conditions-generales-vente, /politique-remboursement, /politique-livraison, /politique-cookies, /conditions-utilisation. Each page: (a) data-testid='legal-page' wrapper present, (b) h1 matches title, (c) 'Dernière mise à jour : 23 juillet 2026' present, (d) legal-back-home link works and returns to `/`, (e) full footer with 6 legal links renders. Footer testids: footer-link-{path}, footer-copyright ('© 2026 Délices Mikaté Royal. Tous droits réservés.'), footer-cookie-prefs ('Préférences cookies'). Cookie banner testids: cookie-consent, cookie-accept-btn, cookie-refuse-btn, cookie-customize-btn, cookie-toggle-analytics, cookie-save-btn, cookie-accept-all-btn, cookie-close-btn. localStorage key: mr_cookie_consent_v1 with shape {necessary:true, analytics:boolean, ts:number}. PostHog gating: window.posthog is a stub before consent (loaded=false); after accept, window.posthog.__loaded becomes true and window.posthog.config is defined. After refuse, stays false. Reload with existing consent hides banner; footer-cookie-prefs re-opens it via `mr:open-cookie-prefs` CustomEvent. Order form (both #commander and #evenements) has: order-consent-row, order-consent-checkbox (unchecked by default), order-consent-link-privacy (href=/politique-confidentialite target=_blank), order-consent-link-terms (href=/conditions-generales-vente target=_blank), allergen-notice ('AVIS ALLERGÈNES' + phrase mentioning arachides, gluten, œufs, lait), and submit button testid order-form-submit-button. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal scroll on legal pages, banner renders fully in viewport with tappable buttons (316px wide). Zero console errors across /, /politique-confidentialite, /politique-cookies, /conditions-generales-vente.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only nuance: `required` HTML attribute on the consent checkbox makes the JS toast fallback message unreachable. The user is still blocked from submitting (native browser popup shows), just via a non-branded UX.
